title: Good product but mine had a blemish.
text:
Good product but mine had a blemish.. Likes: Like the product: Sturdiness, color, and design. Dislikes: Wood putty was used to fill a hole/blemish on headboard. Disappointed that the putty was left to dry in a different color than headboard and no touch up stain or paint was used to conceal putty (see photo).
Instruction schematic diagram for assembly does not show the washers that are required to be installed with bolts. Also no notation to include washer with each bolt to be installed. Took me twice as long to assemble as I needed to backtrack and remove all installed bolts to include a washer for each.
Would be five star rating if not for the blemish. Unfortunate for Poor Manufacturer Quality Control/Inspection judgement call on Zinus allowing this product to be sent out to a customer. All the parts were already pulled out of the delivered box when the blemish was discovered and everything was unpacked and unwrapped. Just a hassle to put back and repack and return so I'm keeping it. Purchased this bed for my new Zinus Green Tea Memory Foam Mattress.

product_metadata.title: ZINUS Alexis Deluxe Wood Platform Bed Frame with Headboard / Wood Slat Support / No Box Spring Needed / Easy Assembly, Rustic Pine, Queen
features: SUPPORTIVE AND STYLISH SLEEP - The perfect spot to begin and end your days, the Alexis Deluxe Wood Platform Bed with Headboard adorns any interior with rustic, timeless charm and excellent mattress support

NO BOX SPRING NEEDED - Reliable and closely spaced wood slats are designed to support and extend the life of your latex, memory foam or spring mattress without the need for a box spring.DURABLE DESIGN - A thick and sturdy solid wood frame is constructed with steel interior framework for longevity; twin size supports a maximum weight capacity of 350 lbs, while all other sizes can support up to 700 lbs
EASY ASSEMBLY - All parts, tools and instructions are shipped straight to your door in one efficiently packed box for simple set-up that takes less than an hour with a friend’s help
Worry-free 5-year limited warranty included; mattress sold separately
description: So much more than just a sturdy support system for your beloved mattress, the Alexis Deluxe Platform Bed Frame with Headboard will charm any bedroom it adorns. This soundly built foundation features a genuine solid wood frame with a rustic finish and unique, natural wood knots and patterns. And to help you eliminate the box spring once and for all, it’s crafted with a set of wood slats engineered to support and extend the life of any mattress you rest upon it. It’s also reinforced with steel for extra durability that’ll have you snoozing soundly for many nights to come. The entire bed is cleverly shipped in one box that arrives at your doorstep with all the tools, parts and instructions you need to assemble it in under an hour. Plus, it includes extra confidence for you to rest even easier in the form of a 5-year worry-free warranty. Once you kick back on top of this sturdy platform, you’ll probably wonder why you didn’t upgrade to such a classy, dependable frame even sooner. That is, until you drift off to dreamland in no time at all.
